about_title: Production presses built to your die
about_text: The presses in this catalogue are NovoTech's premium line of production hydraulic presses: built in Turkey by a press maker with five decades of hydraulic press manufacturing, on welded and machined monoblock frames with chrome-plated hardened cylinders, European hydraulics and Siemens S7 controls, and CE-certified.

Every series is made in standard sizes and to the customer's requirement — table size, stroke, daylight, tonnage, die cushion, heated platens, quick die change and die loading — from a 33 US ton C-frame to 3,307 US ton H-frame presses. Each press is delivered with a CSA-approved panel, a 1-year warranty and spare parts and technical support from NovoTech in Mississauga, Ontario.
